attribution: Synthetic document authored for the Memex eval corpus.
notes: Synthetic FLAT-ODF fixture authored to exercise GFM TABLE fidelity. source.fodt is a native LibreOffice Writer doc (real bordered table), so unlike an HTML table through the writerweb filter (which flattens — see modern-printed/tidewater), the table parses as a proper GFM table. Real findings the parse still surfaces: (1) the table header row splits across lines (each header cell on its own line) — a genuine pymupdf4llm table-fidelity gap; (2) heading levels flatten to H2 (the H1 title becomes ##) + bold-wrap. The ground-truth table uses compact `|a|b|` pipes to match the parser's GFM style so WER measures content/structure, not pipe-spacing. NOTE: proper table scoring needs the structural-F1-for-tables metric (eval-corpus-plan §Scoring), not yet implemented — until then CER/WER on tables carry formatting noise. Thresholds are regression gates calibrated to the measured baseline.
